notes.title: 2023.03.26 Update
notes.notes:
2023.03.26

新神器
 - 金色旋风
  被动:游戏开始时，花费3金币获得军团“赏金猎人”，累计2次三连后，此军团变为金色！
  专属军团--赏金猎人：
    效果：回合结束：其他金色军团获得+2强化，每个金色军团使此军团获得+2强化
    金色效果：其他军团三连后获得+2数量;回合结束：其他金色军团获得+2强化，每个金色军团使此军团获得+2强化
 - 人口契约
  被动：本回合每触发一次人口增加，下回合会增加1金币
 - 吞噬魔盘
  主动：花费0，摧毁所有苦工，使目标军团获得其数量
 - 圣魔十字架
  被动：亡灵军团不能变异，非变异亡灵军团获得恶魔之魂时+1数量
 - 智慧之球
  被动：刷新有几率触发特殊效果！
 - 液态幻象
  被动：被动:主城等级达到4、5、6时，随机复制场上一个军团的原始版到场下。不会复制你已有两个的军团、金色军团和奴隶。
新增的神器将暂时无法获得
但会在接下来的一段时间开放限时免费体验
限时神器下架
限时神器商城中的 金枪、佣兵有道及寒冰魔瓶三个神器现已下架，并加入抽卡池中
这些神器将和此前已经在池中的神器具有相同的出现概率

notes.title: Version update log 2023-03-06
notes.notes:
Version update log

2023-03-06

New artifact

- The Golden Gun (Legend)

Initiative (Cost 1) : Turns a legion on the field gold until the next turn

- The Sellsword (Legend)

Active (Cost 0) : Destroy a non-drudge legion on the field. The next legion you buy this turn is free

- Ice Bottle (Epic)

Passive: Start of Turn: If combat power is above 1000, obtain Ice Demon Ravis and replace this skill with:

Active (cost 0) : Destroy legions on a field, giving Ice Demon Ravis +1 per 1000 combat power

The exclusive Legion of Ice Ravis:

Effects: End of Turn: Gain +1 boost. If the number of legions is greater than 5, the legions turn golden.

Golden Effect: End of Turn: This legion gains +1 boost for every 5 counts

Unit combat power 1250

78 damage 715 health

Movement speed 10 Attack range 40

Attack speed 0.5

Skills - Frost Nova: Delay death when a unit takes fatal damage, start to self-destruct, deal up to 10 enemies range damage of 2.0* attack, and reduce movement speed by 50% for the next 5S

New artifacts will not be available for the time being

But it will be free for a limited time on the next 3 days

After the end of the limited time experience, the balance of the new artifact will be adjusted, and then open the limited time draw card activity!

Limited time to draw cards

The new three artifacts will appear in the new card pool, and the probability of appearing increased by 100%!

Artifact Shard and Shard Mall

Now, after drawing a duplicate artifact in the draw card, you will get a piece of artifact

The number of pieces of artifact obtained is related to the rarity of the artifact drawn

The pieces of artifacts you own can be exchanged for other goods in the Shard Mall

See the game for the items in the Shard Mall

Spoils of war

- Added loot system, now you can view the various items you have (resurrection potions, name change cards, etc.)

collect

You can now view the effects of the Artifact Exclusive Corps in your Artifact Collection!

Name change card

Added item name change card

After purchase, it needs to be used in the profile interface

After use, you can modify the nickname in the game, and the modified nickname still needs to comply with the naming convention
